summary:
plan.md is written (no build or render yet). The obelisk stands 7x7 at x47..53, z47..53 on the y5 summit, steps in to 5x5 at y38 and ends in a pyramid of stairs with a dark tip at y76. Lower 19 courses smooth_quartz, the rest calcite/smooth_sandstone courses: a sharp colour line at y25.
It reads as the Washington Monument by silhouette: a plain white needle on a round granite plaza, ringed by 50 end-rod flagpoles at r16 with stars-and-stripes banners, a great ring walk around the knoll and Mall walks running east-west. Warm froglights sit at its base for dusk.
